sourceRefs.locator: Building history: opening on 30 September 1491, Bayezid II, Abdülûlâ bin Pulad Shah, financing of charitable buildings in Istanbul, warehouses, stable and courtyard.
Opening discussion of Bursa’s markets for Iranian raw silk, the international trade and the growth of local production.

labels.en: The opening of the Koza Han

note.de: Bayezid II. ließ in Bursa eine Handelsherberge errichten. Ihre Einnahmen versorgten Moscheen und Schulen in Istanbul. Im Hof und in den Magazinen arbeiteten Menschen des Seidenhandels.
note.en: Bayezid II commissioned a trading inn in Bursa to generate revenue for mosques and schools in Istanbul. The courtyard and warehouses accommodated people who made their living from silk.
